name: Wake listener help
description: Help mode entries for the Wake listener plugin (help@1): the settings tab, the banner light and the spoken flows.
author: Brett

entries.title: Wake listener
entries.text: The console listens for a wake phrase you set here (several allowed), then takes one command: any console action, plugin command, pipeline command or control@1 target, by voice. A command with missing fields becomes a spoken wizard that asks for each one and confirms. 'Approve' reviews everything waiting on axHub one call at a time.
entries.more: The switch closes the microphone everywhere this console is open. On the console Android app the recognizer runs on the device (offline); in a browser it is the browser's own. The light on the banner shows what the listener is doing: grey = off, green = waiting for the wake phrase, amber = heard it and waiting for a command, accent = a wizard is waiting for your answer, red = an error with the reason. Replies are spoken through the agent voice when it is installed, else the device voice.
entries.tryIt: Say your wake phrase, wait for the chime, then say 'approve'.

entries.title: Mic light
entries.text: Lit while the console listens for its wake phrase. Tap it to switch the listener on or off.
entries.more: Grey: off. Green: idle, waiting for the wake phrase. Amber: awake, say a command. Accent: a wizard or the approvals review is waiting for an answer. Red: the recognizer stopped; the label says why.

entries.title: Say a phrase without the microphone
entries.text: Runs a phrase as if the mic heard it after the wake phrase: from the settings tab's Try it box, or from the API (REST, MCP, CLI, AmberX) as the console action wake-listener.heard:<phrase>.

entries.title: Listen for a wake phrase
entries.text: Turns the wake listener on or off. Off closes the microphone everywhere this console is open, and the light on the banner goes grey.

entries.title: Add a wake phrase
entries.text: Type a phrase and press Add: saying it wakes the console for one command. Several phrases are allowed.

entries.title: Recognizer
entries.text: Which speech engine listens: automatic, on-device in the console app (offline, audio never leaves the device), the browser's own, or none.

entries.title: Awake for a command (seconds)
entries.text: How long the console waits for a command after it hears the wake phrase.

entries.title: A wizard waits for an answer (seconds)
entries.text: How long a spoken wizard waits for each answer before it gives up.

entries.title: Chime on the wake phrase
entries.text: Plays a short chime when the wake phrase is heard, so you know to say the command.

entries.title: Mic light on the banner
entries.text: When the banner shows the mic light: always (grey when off), only while listening, or never.

entries.title: Pause while this page is hidden
entries.text: Stops listening while another tab or app is in front. Off keeps listening in the background where the engine allows it.

entries.title: Say a phrase
entries.text: Type what you would say after the wake phrase, to try it without the microphone.

entries.title: Say it
entries.text: Runs the typed phrase as if the microphone heard it after the wake phrase (the same as the API's wake-listener.heard).

entries.title: Wake listener
entries.text: Settings for the wake listener: wake phrases, the off switch, the recognizer and spoken replies.

entries.title: Wake listener on / off
entries.text: Switches the wake listener on or off from the Plugins menu, the API or by voice.

entries.title: Review approvals by voice
entries.text: Starts a spoken review of everything waiting on axHub, one call at a time.
